Financial control and reporting

Payroll, cash and operations

Inventory, costing and assets

Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

  • Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role.

If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Customer Success Partner, Enterprise

As a Customer Success Partner at CreatorIQ, you will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of high-level enterprise customers, helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through their creator marketing programs. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their goals and align them with CreatorIQ’s platform capabilities, driving long-term adoption, value realization, and program success.

This role will support some of our largest and most sophisticated European customers, with significant representation across beauty, fashion, and luxury. We’re looking for someone who brings a strong understanding of the creator and influencer marketing ecosystem and can confidently advise customers on how to evolve and scale their programs.

You’ll build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, both virtually and in person, and serve as a proactive partner throughout the customer lifecycle. Customer Success Partners are experts in the CreatorIQ platform, fluent in creator and influencer marketing strategy, and passionate about delivering measurable business impact.

You will own the health and retention of your portfolio and will be measured on outcomes including gross retention, platform adoption, customer health, and value realization. As a Paris-based member of a broader European team, you’ll also need to be highly self-directed, comfortable operating with autonomy, and able to build strong internal and customer relationships across locations.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of complex enterprise customers, aligning CreatorIQ’s capabilities to their business goals and driving measurable value.

  • Bring creator and influencer marketing expertise to customer conversations, helping customers evolve their strategies, solve challenges, and build sophisticated, scalable creator programs.

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Drive platform adoption and customer success by understanding each customer’s strategy, analyzing engagement, and identifying opportunities to increase value.

  • Lead strategic engagements including success planning, business reviews, roadmap discussions, and in-person meetings as appropriate.

  • Own customer health and retention across your portfolio, proactively identifying risk and coordinating action plans to support long-term success.

  • Maintain strategic account plans that capture customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, risks, and growth opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to deepen customer adoption and expand the value of CreatorIQ across their organizations.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Services, Support, and Product to deliver a cohesive customer experience and resolve needs effectively.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally while staying current on CreatorIQ capabilities and creator marketing trends, strategies, and best practices to bring relevant insights to customers.

  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across Europe and globally while operating with a high degree of ownership and independence from Paris.

  • Travel within Europe for customer and company meetings as needed, including regular travel to London and occasional travel to other European markets.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • Deep knowledge of creator and influencer marketing, with professional experience working directly with creator programs, platforms, campaigns, or strategies.

  • 3+ years of experience in a strategic, enterprise customer-facing role within creator/influencer marketing, marketing technology, a relevant brand, agency, or SaaS environment.

  • Experience supporting complex enterprise brands and accounts, with the ability to navigate large customer organizations and multiple stakeholders.

  • Beauty, cosmetics, skincare, fashion, or luxury experience strongly preferred, particularly experience working directly with enterprise brands in these industries.

  • Proven ability to manage toward business KPIs, retention goals, customer health, and customer advocacy metrics.

  • Experience identifying customer risk and contributing to retention, renewal, and growth strategies.

  • Skilled at building credibility and relationships across multiple levels, from daily platform users to Director, VP, and executive stakeholders.

  • Confident independently leading strategic customer conversations, including success planning, business reviews, executive conversations, and roadmap discussions.

  • Comfortable translating customer goals into actionable creator marketing and platform strategies with measurable outcomes.

  • Able to use customer, adoption, and performance data to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories.

  • Strong strategic thinker who can also manage the day-to-day execution and follow-through required to move customer initiatives forward.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and self-directed, with the ability to effectively manage a portfolio of complex enterprise customers while working independently.

  • A can-do, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Collaborative and experienced working cross-functionally with teams such as Implementation, Support, Product, Services, Insights, and Sales.

  • Fluent French required, with strong professional English communication skills. Additional European languages are a plus.

  • Based in Paris or within reasonable commuting distance and comfortable working independently as part of a distributed European team.

  • Willing and able to travel regularly within Europe, particularly to London, as customer and business needs require.

  • Comfortable with customer success and productivity tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Notion, Jira, or similar platforms.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We know that benefits play a significant role in your overall compensation. We invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

As a Storage Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's storage product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the storage stack from block storage, distributed filesystems, object storage, and the evolving storage technology that accelerate AI/ML and HPC workloads. You understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale.

You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and storage products.

What You’ll Do

  • Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's storage offerings — including distributed filesystem, block, and object storage to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale.

  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the different storage products must hit.

  • Data strategy and architecture: Drive the data lifecycle, tiering, durability, and failure-domain strategy in close partnership with engineering.

  • Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the storage product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their storage needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company.

  • Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the storage domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning.

  • Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership.

  • Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on storage and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments

  • Strong understanding of storage technologies, including file system, block and object storage.

  • Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one.

  • Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact.

  • Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation.

Bonus

  • You can reason about cloud storage economics, and how tiering across hot, warm, and cold tiers affects cost

  • You've designed, or worked closely on, backup, replication, or disaster recovery products

  • You're comfortable discussing storage performance characteristics: throughput, latency, IOPS, and how they map to real workloads

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints, including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.


Nice to have

  • Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

About Agicap
 
Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 700 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.
 
Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.
 
Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.
 
Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.
 
Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Customer Stories
Our Values

Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients.

Chez Younited, nous pensons que les services financiers devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Everyday financial services : Avec helios by Younited, nous proposons des solutions pour aider chacun à mieux gérer ses finances, tout en construisant notre future offre bancaire du quotidien.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, tu pilotes l’équipe Sécurité Financière de 1ère ligne de défense (LOD1), en charge du traitement des alertes LCB-FT et de screening.

Depuis 2024, Younited a engagé sa transformation pour devenir un acteur bancaire global. Dans ce contexte, tu joues un rôle clé dans la structuration et la fiabilisation du dispositif de sécurité financière, en garantissant la qualité des analyses, le respect des délais et des procédures, ainsi que la maîtrise des risques opérationnels.
 
À la croisée des enjeux opérationnels, réglementaires et managériaux, tu fais le lien entre les exigences de conformité et leur mise en œuvre concrète par les équipes. Tu contribues ainsi à renforcer les contrôles de 1er niveau, à fiabiliser le pilotage de l’activité et à accompagner l’évolution des outils et des pratiques.
 

Missions 🚀 

1) Opérations de sécurité financière (LOD1)
  • Superviser les entrées en relation et les diligences KYC (KYC renforcé, revues périodiques) avec escalade des profils les plus risqués à l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 pour validation
  • Garantir le traitement de 1er niveau des alertes de transaction et de filtrage (sanctions, gel des avoirs, PPE) et l'escalade des alertes documentée vers l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Piloter la gestion des comptes inactifs et le cycle de blocage, d'investigation et de clôture des comptes en lien avec l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Superviser les flux sensibles (virements sortants, recalls, chargebacks)
  • Exécuter les saisies et piloter le prestataire externe en charge des réquisitions judiciaires

2) Pilotage de l'activité

  • Piloter les SLA par flux et s’assurer de leur respect
  • Piloter le prestataire externe et suivre la qualité du traitement des réquisitions judiciaires
  • Être l'interlocuteur opérationnel de l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 sur les sujets LCB-FT

3) Contrôle, remédiation et transformation

  • Piloter la remédiation des recommandations d'audit et de contrôle jusqu'à leur clôture
  • Suivre les audits et le contrôle permanent et les plans d'action associés
  • Déployer le plan de contrôle de 1er niveau et renforcer les contrôles insuffisants et les actions correctrices
  • Rédiger et maintenir l’ensemble des procédures et modes opératoires du département
  • Former et accompagner l'équipe sur le traitement des alertes de surveillance des opérations et à la rédaction des examens renforcés
  • Faire évoluer les outils et automatiser les traitements, en accompagnant l'équipe dans le changement
  • Participer à la consolidation des données pour les comités des risques

4) Reporting réglementaire

  • Coordonner avec, l’équipe en charge de la LOD2, la production de données fiables et leur analyse, pour les reportings et les demandes des superviseurs
  • Structurer et automatiser les indicateurs de l'activité

5) Management

  • Encadrer l'équipe et la faire monter en compétences
  • Organiser l'activité selon les risques ; piloter les délais, les stocks et la qualité
  • Appuyer l'équipe sur les dossiers complexes et sensibles avant escalade

À propos de toi 👇

  • Tu as 7 ans d’expérience minimum en sécurité financière et fraude dans un établissement bancaire, une fintech ou un cabinet de conseil, dont une expérience en management d’équipe opérationnelle
  • Tu as une expérience concrète de structuration ou de refonte d’un dispositif opérationnel : procédures, contrôles de 1er niveau et outils
  • Tu as déjà piloté la remédiation de recommandations d’audit ou de contrôle
  • Tu sais traduire les exigences de conformité en pratiques opérationnelles claires
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance de la réglementation bancaire, notamment du contrôle interne, de la LCB-FT, du RGPD et de la DSP2
  • Tu es capable de conduire un projet transverse, de prioriser les actions et d’accompagner le changement
  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur d’analyse, de capacité de décision, de pédagogie et d’implication directe dans les travaux

Processus de recrutement 📅

  • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître, échanger autour de tes motivations et te présenter plus en détail Younited (30 min)
  • Second échange en visio avec Antoine, ton futur manager et directeur des opérations chez Younited pour parler des attendus du poste de manière plus approfondie (60 min)
  • Une étude de cas à restituer en physique pour évaluer tes compétences au travers d’une mise en situation appliquée à une problématique liée au poste (60 min)
  • Un dernier entretien en visio avec Rémi, ton futur N+2 et CEO France chez Younited, pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et les évolutions possibles (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)

  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)

  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited

  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso

  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés

  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales

  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an

  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)

  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 

  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur

  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Partnership Operations Intern, you will help turn partner relationships into repeatable growth. You will have real responsibility for making partners successful, helping opportunities move forward, and building the systems that allow our partner ecosystem to scale.

This is a very hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how partnerships and the indirect channel really work. You will work directly with a wide range of external actors, including agency and consultancy leaders, partner sales and delivery teams, technology partners, and customers, while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product at Dust.

You will not be limited to observing or executing a narrow checklist. You will own projects, see their impact, and help shape how Dust works with partners from the ground up.

What you'll do

Keep partners moving and growing

  • Animate the partner community through regular updates, follow-ups, check-ins, and activation initiatives.

  • Support partner onboarding and help partners find the right information, people, and resources at the right time.

  • Reply to partner questions and requests promptly, with clear next steps and strong follow-through.

  • Keep partner records, documentation, trackers, and workflows accurate and up to date across HubSpot, Introw, and Crossbeam.

  • Help design and improve scalable partner infrastructure, including onboarding flows, partner tiering, enablement tracking, and partner activity monitoring.

  • Track partner KPIs and help maintain dashboards covering activation, pipeline, attribution, engagement, and performance.

  • Identify recurring friction points and turn them into clearer processes, automations, or reusable resources.

Turn partner opportunities into revenue

  • Support partners throughout the deal creation process, from the first opportunity to a qualified pipeline item and a closed deal.

  • Create quotes and coordinate the information needed to move deals forward accurately and quickly.

  • Help maintain clean deal registration and partner attribution workflows in HubSpot.

  • Use tools such as Default, n8n, and Dust to reduce manual steps and improve visibility across the deal lifecycle.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

  • Back Market runs on data. Every insight we surface, every model we build, every anomaly we catch is a step toward making refurbished tech the world's obvious choice — not the alternative.

    Our Data, Analytics & Insights team is expanding, and we're opening a Senior Data Analyst role.

    Wherever you land, you'll own a domain end-to-end — from the data model to the boardroom decision. These aren't reporting roles. They're roles where your analytical judgment drives real business direction.

    What You'll Do:

    • Contribute to 12M+ sales forecasting and P&L budgeting, translating initiative impacts into tactical recommendations when the trajectory drifts

    • Monitor and diagnose commercial performance for US & UK market — weekly, proactively, with course-correction plans ready before anyone asks

    • Build data models and tooling that surface actionable pricing signals to the commercial and revenue teams

    • Enable self-service access to pricing and supply health data across the organisation

    • Own your analytical domain end-to-end — from data model to decision, you're the go-to person

    • Partner directly with senior leadership — not just delivering analyses, but shaping the questions we ask


    What does a “typical” week look like in this role?

    • Evaluating new strategic initiatives and experiments through rigorous A/B testing and incrementality analysis

    • Architecting and maintaining robust measurement frameworks from scratch

    • Developing self-service dashboards and analytical tooling for cross-functional teams

    • Partnering directly with domain leads across Commercial, Care, and Shipping to shape strategy

    • Conducting analytical peer reviews and sharing insights across the broader data organisation



    🛠️ Tech Stack
    What the team works with day-to-day:

    • Data Warehouse: Google BigQuery

    • Transformation: dbt

    • Visualisation & BI: Omni, Amplitude

    • Languages: SQL (essential), Python (very useful)

    • Experimentation: A/B testing and incrementality frameworks



    You should apply if You have:

    • Strong SQL proficiency and comfort working with large, complex datasets — you can build the query and explain what the result means for the business in the same breath

    • A track record of owning analytical problem spaces end-to-end — outcomes that shaped business direction, not just answered one-off questions

    • A rigorous analytical mindset: you understand causal vs. correlational reasoning, know the limits of your data, and can design a measurement framework from scratch

    • Excellent communication and storytelling skills — you distil complex, multi-variable analyses into crisp narratives that move senior stakeholders to act

    • Experience in business analytics, commercial strategy, or a customer-facing operations domain (marketplace, e-commerce, logistics, or similar)

    • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, or equivalent hands-on analytical ownership

    Nice to have:

    • Python proficiency for statistical work, modelling, or analytical automation

    • Domain familiarity: pricing/revenue management for Commercial; care platform experience (Zendesk, Intercom) for Care; logistics or carrier analytics for Shipping

    • Experience designing experiments in an operational context (A/B tests, holdouts, or incrementality measurement)

    Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse analytical backgrounds and unconventional paths to expertise.

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Product Principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In almost 7 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1300+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1M+ small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Autopilot is Pennylane’s AI add-on for accounting firms, designed to automate bookkeeping and move accountants from execution to supervision—with a clear ambition: a 1-click VAT return.

The challenge is no longer only to build a powerful product, but to activate it at scale, prove its value and turn adoption into revenue.

As the first PM of the new Bookkeeping / Autopilot Growth squad, you will play a central role in making that happen. You will help hundreds of thousands of companies adopt Autopilot, connect firms to the value it already delivers and shape Pennylane’s AI monetization strategy.

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Product Manager

As a Senior Product Manager, you will join a 100+ person Product organization, working with 300+ engineers to make Autopilot the default way firms run their bookkeeping.

You will:

  • Understand what drives adoption. Talk to firm owners and accountants, analyse product data with SQL, Amplitude and Metabase, and identify where firms hesitate to activate Autopilot.

  • Turn insights into measurable growth. Define clear hypotheses, metrics and stop criteria, then run B2B experiments through holdouts, cohort analysis and staged rollouts.

  • Own the growth strategy. Set your OKRs, shape the roadmap and focus the squad on the initiatives that drive activation, trust, usage and revenue.

  • Build with a cross-functional squad. Partner closely with a Product Designer, Engineering Manager and product-focused engineers, starting with MVPs and iterating based on what you learn.

  • Work across the ecosystem. Collaborate with the squads building Bookkeeping and Autopilot, as well as Data, Product Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success and Account Management.

  • Scale adoption beyond the product. Design in-product and lifecycle experiences that help firms self-serve, while providing commercial teams with the signals they need to support adoption.

  • Build for France and Germany from day one. Design configurable solutions rather than simple translations, and work with the German team to make what works in France scalable internationally.

  • Help define a new way of building product. Work agentic-first, design for supervision and stay relentlessly user-obsessed—using AI tools and agents every day to explore data, prototype and move faster.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month

  • You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week

  • You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers)

  • You'll understand how Autopilot works: what it automates, how confident it is, and where it still needs a human

  • You'll have mapped the Autopilot adoption funnel, at company and firm level: eligible, enabled, expanded, paying

Within 3 months

  • You'll have set the adoption baseline and targets with your manager

  • You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on activation, hand in hand with your Product Designer and Engineers

  • You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR

  • You will have set up your continuous discovery routine with firms and be ready to build your roadmap

Within 6 months

  • You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap

  • You'll have shipped at least one step change in how firms activate Autopilot

  • You'll have made the time Autopilot saves visible to firm owners

  • You'll have prepared the switch to paid with Pricing, Product Marketing and Sales

  • You'll have equipped Account Managers and CSMs with an adoption playbook they actually use

  • You'll share your learnings and playbooks with the other Autopilot squads and with Germany

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to;

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us;

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it;

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness;

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French;

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment;

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to the French Alps and it was fabulous !).

 

And.. If you're based in 🇫🇷 :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get 10 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • You will first have a general chat with Charlène, Talent Acquisition Manager (45 min)

  • You'll then have a discussion with one member of our Product team to assess the fit and the Product culture (45 min)

  • You'll then pass a live case study on an Autopilot adoption problem with 2 Product Managers from our team (1h15)

  • You'll have a final round with Tancrède (our CPO) and a Group PM or a Head of Product (60 min)

We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

Language

For this specific role, a full fluent level in French 🇫🇷 is required.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience driving growth, adoption or monetization, ideally in B2B SaaS or a scaled B2C product, with measurable results;

  • Strong data fluency and hands-on analytical skills: you can go from SQL query to dashboard to actionable decision, using Amplitude or equivalent tools—even when the data is imperfect;

  • Rigour in experimentation: you know when sample sizes are too small for A/B testing and can design robust holdouts, cohorts and staged rollouts instead;

  • A strong understanding of AI-powered products: you can assess automation quality across confidence, accuracy, coverage and evaluation—and know what it takes to build user trust;

  • Excellent product sense and user research skills: you can uncover what makes professional users comfortable delegating critical work to a machine;

  • Strong cross-functional leadership: you influence and align multiple squads and commercial teams without relying on formal authority;

  • Clear, structured communication skills, with fluency in French and professional proficiency in English;

  • Previous Product Management experience in a scale-up or large technology company.

Experience in accounting is not required, but curiosity for the domain and comfort with complexity are essential. Experience with pricing and packaging, free-to-paid transitions, paid add-ons, lifecycle/CRM or sales-assisted PLG would be a strong plus.

About the Role

The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design.

You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Material Flow Design: Analyze, design, and optimize the receiving, storage, movement, and lineside presentation of all production and non-production materials to eliminate technician search and walk time.

  • Plan for Every Part (PFEP) & Data Ownership: Build, maintain, and own the PFEP database defining part dimensions, packaging specifications, containerization, storage media, replenishment triggers (Kanban/min-max), and delivery frequencies.

  • Factory & Warehouse Layout Engineering: Create conceptual and detailed 2D/3D facility layouts (AutoCAD/CAD) for warehouse racking, supermarket zones, tugger routes, and lineside staging to support scalable production rates.

  • Custom Hardware & Packaging Development: Design, procure, and deploy custom material handling equipment, including kitting carts, lineside racks, dunnage, and returnable packaging, to protect sensitive components and ensure seamless point-of-use presentation.

  • Constraint & Bottleneck Mitigation: Conduct daily Gemba walks, time studies, and root-cause analyses to proactively identify material flow bottlenecks, implement poka-yoke (error-proofing) workflows, and resolve floor constraints before they impact build schedules.

  • Cross-Functional & NPI Alignment: Represent material flow readiness in production, NPI, and operational review meetings. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations Leadership to support new line launches, facility expansions, and engineering changes.

  • Performance & Data-Driven Optimization: Extract and analyze production, inventory, and cycle-time data using SQL and ERP/WMS systems to right-size buffer stock, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and drive down material handling costs.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Just-In-Time (JIT), Kanban, Plan for Every Part (PFEP), and Six Sigma principles applied on an active production floor.

  • Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for facility layout engineering and custom cart/rack design.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

Owkin is looking for a Customer Support Specialist to own first-level support for K-Pro, Owkin's AI research platform for biopharma R&D, used by AstraZeneca, Sanofi, Servier and Boehringer Ingelheim.

Our clients have made major investments to access K-Pro, and their contracts come with strict response and resolution SLAs. You will be their first point of contact during business hours: the person who understands their problem quickly, keeps them informed, and gets the right engineering, product or customer success people moving. You will also help shape how support works at Owkin, including where AI and agentisation make it better.

 

In particular, you will:

Own the support flow

  • Own incoming tickets during business hours as the first line of support for all K-Pro clients

  • Triage every ticket: set priority (P1 to P4) and the impacted service, and route it to the right team

  • Keep SLAs on track: follow up on open tickets, escalate early when a deadline is at risk

  • Communicate clear, timely updates to users and CSMs throughout the ticket lifecycled 

 Go deep on the product

  • Diagnose issues directly with users: reproduce bugs, check data and configurations, and give engineers a clean, actionable report

  • Learn K-Pro in depth (its features, the datasets clients use, how login, API access, exports and permissions work, and the research questions clients bring to it) so you can resolve most issues without escalating

  • Recognise when a result looks scientifically wrong and when it's a usage question

Turn support into insight

  • Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback, doc updates or process fixes

  • Track and report on support metrics (response time, SLA compliance, first contact resolution, volume) and give actionable insights to the team.

Own the knowledge base

  • Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved

  • Turn one-off fixes into reusable answers for clients and for the support team

Improve support with AI

  • Identify where automation and AI tools (triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval) would save time or improve quality

  • Work with R&Tech Operations to build, test and improve these workflows

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Proven technical support or customer support for B2B software, ideally SaaS, with enterprise clients

  • A track record handling SLA-bound support with demanding customers, and staying calm under pressure

  • Strong technical curiosity: comfortable with APIs, logs, data and configurations; basic SQL or scripting is a plus

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling and building or improving agentic support workflows (AI-assisted triage, automated routing, LLM-powered drafting), and the judgment to know when automation fits

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain technical issues to scientists and to engineers alike

  • Experience with support tooling such as Zendesk, Linear and PagerDuty, or equivalent

  • Able to follow runbooks and escalation paths, and to know when to deviate from them

  • A habit of turning fixes into documentation and patterns into insights

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience in life sciences, biopharma or another regulated industry is a strong plus

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • You handle the full ticket flow for all K-Pro clients with SLAs met

  • CSMs rely on your signals to anticipate account risks

  • The help center covers the most frequent ticket types

  • You have shipped at least one automation that measurably improves support 

#LI-HB1

 

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

Tu rejoins l’équipe produit d’un de nos clients grands comptes, et c’est toi qui as la main sur ton produit. D’une mission à l’autre, tu changes d’univers : retail, luxe, banque, secteur public. Peu de postes te font voir autant de contextes en si peu de temps.

🎯 Tes missions

  • Discovery : tu vas voir les utilisateurs, tu mènes les entretiens et tu valides tes hypothèses avant de lancer quoi que ce soit en dev

  • Conception : tu construis les solutions avec les designers, du prototype jusqu’aux tests utilisateurs

  • Delivery : tu tiens le backlog et la roadmap et tu arbitres les priorités. Le client t’écoute parce que tu arrives avec des arguments

  • Pilotage : tu suis tes KPI et tes OKR après chaque mise en prod, et tu fais évoluer ta roadmap avec ce que tu observes

  • Animation : tu animes les rituels agiles et les ateliers avec les équipes et les métiers côté client

  • Partage : tu présentes ce que tu as appris en mission aux autres PM Hubvisory, et tu profites de ce qu’ils ont appris eux aussi

Tu ne pars jamais seul(e) : un manager te suit pendant tes missions, et tu peux compter sur la communauté produit dès que tu bloques sur un sujet.

🧭 Ton évolution

Après le grade Confirmé vient le grade Senior, avec des contextes plus exigeants et des PM plus juniors à accompagner. La plupart de nos managers et leads ont commencé consultants chez nous, donc ton prochain poste peut très bien être en interne.

💡 Pourquoi Hubvisory

  • On fait du Product et de l’IA depuis 2016, et rien d’autre. Autour de toi, tout le monde parle produit

  • Tu interviens chez Dior, Decathlon, Leroy Merlin, France TV…

  • Tu commences par deux semaines au Campus Hubvisory avant ta première mission, puis tu as accès à plus de 1 000 h de contenus

  • Ton salaire est revu deux fois par an

  • Quand l’entreprise va bien, tu en profites directement : jusqu’à 22 % des profits sont redistribués en intéressement, à parts égales

💰 Salaire : 46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel, plus l’intéressement et les primes (commerciale, ancienneté sur mission, cooptation).


👤 Ton profil

  • Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience comme PM sur des produits digitaux dans des environnements grands comptes

  • Tu as déjà fait de la discovery avec de vrais utilisateurs, et tu as envie d’en faire plus

  • Backlog, priorisation, roadmap : tu connais, et tu as envie de pratiquer dans d’autres contextes

  • Tu aimes convaincre, et défendre une décision face à un client ne te fait pas peur

🔄 Le process

  1. Un premier échange avec l’équipe RH

  2. Un cas pratique en live avec un Manager (1h30)

  3. Un entretien avec un VP ou un des cofondateurs (1h30)

  4. Un appel RH de 15 minutes pour la proposition

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

Aujourd'hui, une IA sait remplir un backlog.

Rédiger des user stories, synthétiser des entretiens, proposer une priorisation : la production devient une commodité. Ce qui ne l'est pas : décider de ce qui mérite d'être construit, puis fédérer une organisation autour de cette décision.

C'est ce métier que tu exerces chez Hubvisory. Tu interviens auprès de grands comptes comme Club Med, SNCF, TF1 ou Saint-Gobain, sur des produits où les arbitrages sont structurants. Tu n'exécutes pas un brief : tu le challenges.

Tes missions

  • Identifier ce qui crée de la valeur. Entretiens utilisateurs, JTBD, story mapping. Tu pars d'hypothèses et tu construis des preuves.

  • Arbitrer. Roadmap, OKR, priorisation : tu tranches entre enjeux business, usages et contraintes tech, et tu assumes tes choix face à des interlocuteurs exigeants.

  • Piloter le delivery. Backlog, rituels, environnement agile. Tu tiens le rôle de PM en autonomie et tu challenges les pratiques de la squad.

  • Mesurer ton impact et défendre tes décisions. Tu définis les indicateurs, tu suis les résultats de tes choix et tu les portes devant les parties prenantes.

  • Faire de l'IA un levier. Tu l'utilises pour gagner en efficacité, en gardant la maîtrise de ton jugement.

Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM reconnu pour sa capacité à décider en contexte d'incertitude. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal.

Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory

  • Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

  • Un rôle sur le quoi, pas seulement sur le comment. Notre positionnement Product & IA nous place là où se crée la valeur.

  • Une progression alignée sur ton impact. Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, passages de grade fondés sur la performance et non sur l'ancienneté.

  • Un onboarding structuré. Un parcours collectif et individuel, avec un plan de formation et une montée en charge progressive. Tu es accompagné par un buddy et un mentor dédiés, et tu as accès à 1000h de contenu à la carte.

  • Une taille humaine. Avec 135+ consultants, chacun est identifié, écouté et accompagné.


Le profil recherché

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux. Une expérience en conseil ou en grand groupe est un vrai plus.

  • Indispensables : maîtrise de la Discovery et du Delivery, capacité à avancer sans cadrage parfait, culture de la mesure d'impact.

  • Atouts : usage concret de l'IA dans ta pratique produit, culture SAFe ou agilité à l'échelle.

  • Savoir-être : autonomie, posture client solide, engagement dans le collectif (chez Hubvisory, tu t’impliques à la fois chez client et au sein du cabinet).

Le process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un RH : ton projet, notre modèle, tes attentes (45 min)

  3. Projection stratégique avec un VP ou un cofondateur : posture et vision (90 min)

  4. Échange de closing avec un RH (15 min)

Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

VOS MISSIONS

RELATION CLIENT & DÉVELOPPEMENT DES VENTES

  •       Participer à la mise en œuvre des recommandations de Visual Merchandising et veiller à leur bonne application au quotidien.

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

We are looking for an exceptional Software Team Lead who combines deep software understanding with the ability to understand user needs, develop people, and turn company priorities into coordinated execution.

Our software team works across infrastructure, cybersecurity, remote drone updates and fleet management, ground station applications, launch box software, and radio unit integration. You will lead this growing team in close partnership with our existing Software Technical Lead, who owns technical direction and architecture; you will own planning, project delivery and people leadership.

Working with the CTO, Head of Engineering, and other team leads, you will shape the software roadmap and align commitments with company milestones.
