About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Managing Assistant for our Head of Web: someone who can genuinely take work off her plate, not just coordinate it, and who is confident working directly in our web tool stack (WordPress, CMS, web tech).

This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing.

You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards.

At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction.

The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase.


What you'll do

Project Management

  • Independently manage smaller website projects from kick-off through design, development, testing and launch.

  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects.

  • Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery.

  • Translate client requirements into clear tasks, priorities and deliverables.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early.

  • Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches.

  • Keep clients informed about progress, next steps and upcoming milestones.

Support the Head of Web

  • Support the Head of Web in coordinating larger and more complex website projects.

  • Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting.

  • Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Handle day-to-day client requests and coordinate their implementation with the team.

  • Maintain clear, friendly and professional communication with clients.

  • Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time.

Key & Essential Skills

Project Management Experience

  • Some experience running or closely supporting website projects (agency or consultancy a plus); full PM seniority is not required.

  • Ability to independently manage smaller projects while supporting larger, more complex initiatives.

  • Strong organizing skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including designers and developers.

  • Good understanding of project budgets, timelines, scope and change requests.

Technical & Digital Understanding

  • Solid understanding of website development processes, from design to launch.

  • Real hands-on experience with WordPress (ideally also Payload or similar): you work in these tools confidently, not just know the interface.

  • Basic understanding of UX, digital marketing, SEO and website analytics.

  • Ability to understand technical discussions and translate them into clear actions.

  • Experience with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana or similar platforms.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation and daily workflows.

Communication & Organisation

  • Fluent professional German and strong English communication skills.

  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with clients.

  • Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues.

  • Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership. You don't just coordinate tasks; you make sure things actually get done.

  • You're one step ahead. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be asked.

  • You bring structure. You enjoy organising information, managing priorities and keeping multiple projects moving.

  • You're a strong communicator. You know how to keep clients informed, manage expectations and communicate professionally.

  • You're detail-oriented. You notice missing information, unclear requirements and potential problems before they become bigger issues.

  • You're a team player. You're equally comfortable leading your own projects and supporting someone else in delivering larger initiatives.

  • You're adaptable. You can switch between project management, client communication and operational tasks without losing track of priorities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the variety of agency work, likes taking responsibility and gets satisfaction from making complex workflows run smoothly.

You'll have the opportunity to manage your own projects while working closely with an experienced Head of Web, gaining exposure to larger enterprise clients and more complex digital initiatives.

Perks

  • Flat hierarchies and a results-oriented working environment.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities and room to grow within the company.

How to Apply

SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world

SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival.

We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies.


The Role

You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will:

  • Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most
  • Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one
  • Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks
  • Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust
  • Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning
  • Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven


What We're Looking For

  • Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on
  • Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool
  • Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it
  • Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you
  • Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision
  • Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits
  • Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience
  • Language: English. German is a plus for shop-floor conversations.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at Zurich, Switzerland, with regular time on the shop floor at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped
  • Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship
  • Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs
  • Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these

data.description:
Overview

Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence.

At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence.

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do

  • Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

  • Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

  • Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

  • Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

  • Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

  • Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are

  • A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

  • Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

  • Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

  • A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

  • High ownership and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

  • Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

  • Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

  • A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements

  • Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

  • Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

  • Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

  • Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change.

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence.

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

In kurz: Du führst und befüllst unseren TikTok- und Instagram-Account.

data.description:
Most CFOs inherit a finance function.

This one gets to build it.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where we stand

Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round.

We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone.

That is the opening.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything financial:

  • Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time.
  • Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage.
  • The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded.
  • A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise.

You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision.

There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly.

The first year

Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design.

You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream.

You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers.

By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it.

You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business.

You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter.

Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action

The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally!

Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered.

Wir bauen Marken, die im Regal funktionieren.

Nicht nur auf Slides. Nicht nur auf Instagram.

Schnell. Sichtbar. Greifbar. Skalierbar.

Wir entwickeln und skalieren Marken, die Design, Produkt und Performance kompromisslos verbinden und genau dort gewinnen, wo es zählt: im Markt.

Über 90’000 Verkaufspunkte weltweit.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Limit.

Wir suchen einen Art Director (100%).

Keinen klassischen Designer.

Wir suchen den kreativen Kopf unseres gesamten Brand Powerhouses.

Jemanden mit einem klaren, tiefen Verständnis für FMCG Design. Jemanden, der weiss, was im Regal stoppt, Aufmerksamkeit gewinnt und Produkte verkauft.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt. Von Packaging über Markenwelten bis hin zu den kleinsten Details, die am Ende den Unterschied machen.

Jemanden, der Bestehendes hinterfragt, Dinge besser machen will und nicht akzeptiert, „wie es schon immer war“.

Die Rolle ist anspruchsvoll, schnell und sehr hands-on.

Wir suchen keinen Verwalter.

Wir suchen einen Macher.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Tempo bringt und Dinge mit hoher Qualität konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der Marken aktiv weiterentwickeln will. Nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern bis zum fertigen Produkt im Regal.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest alles, was unsere Marken visuell und kreativ nach vorne bringt – mit klarem Fokus auf FMCG Performance im Markt.

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer Konzepte über alle Brands hinweg mit Fokus auf Sichtbarkeit, Wiedererkennung und Wirkung
  • Aufbau, Schärfung und Weiterentwicklung starker Markenwelten mit konsistenter Handschrift
  • Bestehendes hinterfragen, challengen und aktiv verbessern – nicht verwalten
  • Gestaltung von Packaging mit klarer FMCG-Logik: aufmerksamkeitsstark, markengerecht und mit Fokus auf Conversion am Regal
  • Entwicklung von Designs für Web, Social und Marketing Assets mit Fokus auf Performance statt nur Ästhetik
  • Ideen schnell, pragmatisch und effizient umsetzen – ohne sich in endlosen Abstimmungen zu verlieren
  • Aktiver Einsatz von AI und modernen Tools, um Workflow, Geschwindigkeit und Output kontinuierlich zu verbessern
  • Projekte eigenständig steuern und umsetzen – von der Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt im Markt
  • Steuerung von Freelancern und externen Partnern mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Brands sowie dem gesamten Team
  • Blick fürs Ganze: vom Produkt über Kommunikation bis hin zum physischen Umfeld

Du machst aus Design Produkte, die verkaufen. Und aus Kreativität Performance.

Qualifikation

  • 2–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im kreativen Bereich (Design, Art Direction o.Ä.)
  • Starkes Portfolio mit echten FMCG- oder Retail-Projekten und sichtbaren Resultaten
  • Sehr gute Skills in Figma sowie Erfahrung in UI und Web
  • Erfahrung in Packaging, Social Media, Web und Print
  • Tiefes Verständnis für FMCG Design, Retail, Consumer Behavior und Kaufentscheidungen
  • Du hinterfragst Dinge und entwickelst sie weiter
  • Du denkst nicht nur in Ästhetik, sondern in Wirkung, Performance und Ergebnissen
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, schnell, hands-on und lösungsorientiert
  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und treibst Projekte aktiv voran
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung statt auf Briefings zu warten
  • Du nutzt AI als sinnvolles Tool im kreativen Alltag
  • Deutsch & English

Was nicht zu der Rolle passt

  • Rein ästhetisches Denken ohne Verständnis für Markt, Konsumenten und Wirkung
  • Kreative ohne echtes Interesse an FMCG, Retail und marktorientiertem Design
  • Sehr starre oder übermässig prozessgetriebene Arbeitsweisen
  • Menschen, die primär auf Vorgaben warten statt selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Menschen, die Konzepte lieben, aber Schwierigkeiten mit Umsetzung und Geschwindigkeit haben

Benefits

  • Direktes Arbeiten mit dem Head of Brands
  • Echten Einfluss auf Marken, Produkte und deren Erfolg im Markt
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen statt endlosen Abstimmungsrunden
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum, Dinge wirklich zu bewegen

Wenn du etwas bewegen willst, dann bist du hier richtig.

Du wirst hier nicht einfach gestalten.

Du wirst Marken bauen.

Produkte entwickeln, die sichtbar werden.

Produkte, die im Regal stoppen.

Produkte, die gewinnen.

Und Produkte, die Menschen kaufen.

Wenn du jemand bist, der Dinge nicht nur schön machen, sondern erfolgreich machen will, dann sollten wir sprechen.

data.description:
International Brands is a fast-growing Swiss company in the Personal Care / FMCG space. With our brands, we bring products into tens of thousands of retail locations worldwide, from drugstores and leading retail chains to e-commerce.

We build brands that work on shelf.

Not just on slides. Not just on Instagram.

Fast. Visible. Tangible. Scalable.

We develop and scale brands that combine design, product and performance without compromise and win exactly where it matters most: in the market.

More than 90,000 retail locations worldwide.

And we are nowhere near our limit.

We are looking for an Art Director (100%).

Not a traditional designer.

We are looking for the creative mind behind our entire brand powerhouse.

Someone with a deep understanding of FMCG design. Someone who knows what stops consumers at shelf, captures attention and drives sales.

Someone who takes ownership. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference.

Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.”

This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on.

We are not looking for an administrator.

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality.

Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market.

Aufgaben

You own everything that moves our brands visually and creatively forward with a clear focus on FMCG performance in the market.

  • Develop and execute creative concepts across all brands with a focus on visibility, recognition and impact
  • Build, sharpen and continuously evolve strong brand worlds with a consistent visual identity
  • Challenge existing approaches and actively improve things instead of simply maintaining them
  • Design packaging with clear FMCG logic: attention-grabbing, brand-right and built to convert at shelf
  • Develop web, social and marketing assets focused on performance, not aesthetics alone
  • Turn ideas into reality quickly, pragmatically and efficiently without getting stuck in endless feedback loops
  • Actively leverage AI and modern tools to improve workflows, speed and creative output
  • Lead projects independently from idea to finished product in market
  • Manage freelancers and external partners with a high quality standard
  • Work closely with the Head of Brands and the broader team
  • Think beyond design with a holistic perspective from products and communication to the physical environment

Turn design into products that sell. Turn creativity into performance.

Qualifikation

  • 2–5+ years of experience in a creative role (Design, Art Direction or similar)
  • Strong portfolio with real FMCG or retail work and proven execution
  • Very strong Figma skills with experience in UI and web
  • Experience across packaging, social media, web and print
  • Deep understanding of FMCG design, retail and consumer behavior
  • You challenge things and constantly look for ways to improve them
  • You do not only think about aesthetics, but about impact, performance and results
  • You are independent, hands-on, fast and solution-oriented
  • You take initiative and actively drive projects forward
  • You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions
  • You use AI as a practical tool in your daily creative workflow
  • German & English

What does not fit this role:

Purely aesthetic thinking without understanding market dynamics, consumers and commercial impact

Creative profiles without genuine interest in FMCG, retail and market-driven design

Very rigid or overly process-driven ways of working

People who wait for instructions instead of taking ownership

People who love concepts but struggle with execution and speed

Benefits

Direct collaboration with the Head of Brands

Real impact on brands, products and their success in market

Fast decisions instead of endless alignment rounds

High ownership and the opportunity to truly build and shape things

If you want to build something meaningful, this is the place.

You will not simply design.

You will build brands.

You will develop products that get noticed.

Products that stop consumers at shelf.

Products that win.

Products that people buy.

If you are someone who wants to create things that are not just beautiful, but successful, we should talk.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

  • Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

  • Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

  • Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures.

  • Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot.

  • Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it.

  • Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours.

Who We're Looking For

A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots.

Your Background

  • 3+ years building robotics simulation or RL training environments.

  • Hands-on with Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab; MuJoCo or Gazebo also considered.

  • Strong Python; C++ a plus.

  • 3D data: point clouds, meshes, scene formats such as USD.

  • GPU-parallel simulation and reinforcement learning workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Legged robots.

  • Photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting or other scene reconstruction.

  • ROS 2.

  • Thermal or lidar sensor modelling.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

  • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

  • Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.

  • Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.

Nice to Have

  • Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.

  • Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning.

  • Robotics or embodied AI.

  • Simulation for data generation.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

Do you want to have an excellent experience as an employee in one of the most pioneering toy companies in the market? Are you passionate about games and driven to provide exceptional products and services to customers worldwide?

This is the company you are looking for!

At Jumbo Group, we are not just an international company; we are an international playground. Our world is filled with games, puzzles, and toys that spread joy and inspire creativity across the globe. We enjoy a robust presence throughout Europe and in all corners of the world.

About the role

Are you ready to make our brands shine – both online and offline? As Marketing Specialist, you’ll take full ownership of a selection of Jumbo’s brands across the Benelux and Nordics. From strategy to execution, from campaign concept to retail catalogue — you’ll manage your brands full journey.

You translate global brand strategies into local plans that drive awareness, engagement and sales at retail. You’ll also make sure your brands perform at their best on all online platforms.

In this dynamic role, you’ll work closely with the Marketing Manager, the local Sales teams, Product Development, the global Brand team, and the local eCommerce manager. Together, you’ll make sure Jumbo’s brands are top of mind for retailers and consumers– no two days are the same.

What you’ll be working on:

Brand & Campaign Management

· Take ownership of your brand portfolio in Benelux & Nordics.

· Translate global brand strategies into local brand plans and activation strategies.

· Manage the local assortment: know your products inside out, select the right new launches together with commercial team, and ensure the best fit for your markets.

· Be a sparring partner for local and global teams, bringing in fresh ideas and creativity and ensure alignment across markets.

· Monitor brand performance, track results and adjust plans accordingly. Share insights with the sales teams and global team.

· Create and manage impactful campaigns, events & retail activations (ATL and BTL) in close collaboration with sales and e-commerce.

· Work closely with creative, media, influencer, social media and activation agencies.

· Create presentations and sell-in decks for sales, retailers and partners.

· Communicate plans, updates and best practices clearly across internal teams and external partners.

E-Commerce & Digital Marketing

· Ensure strong online visibility and conversion for your brands through optimised product content.

· Execute retail media campaigns and product activations on Bol.com, Amazon and other key online partners, together with the local e-com manager.

· Align your brand presence across Jumbo’s local social channels in collaboration with our SoMe agency and fellow Marketing Specialists.

· Share and apply digital insights and best practices across markets.

What you bring to the team

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communication, Business Administration, Digital Commerce, or a related field.

· Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in Marketing, Brand Management, Trade Marketing or Digital Marketing.

· Hands-on with e-commerce platforms (Bol.com, Amazon or similar) and retail media campaigns.

· Affinity with social media management and content creation.

· Analytical and organisational skills; confident with Excel, PowerPoint and analytics tools.

· Experience in the toy, entertainment, or FMCG sector is a plus, but not mandatory.

What makes you a great fit

· You’re a strong multitasker who loves variety – product launches, campaigns, activations, all in one week? Bring it on!

· A creative storyteller with fresh ideas and an eye for detail.

· A confident communicator in Dutch & English; French or a Nordic language is a plus.

Nederland

Een commerciële buitendienstfunctie waarin jij zelf een markt opbouwt, met de slagkracht van een internationale producent achter je. Bij IKO krijg je de vrijheid om jouw eigen commerciële koers te bepalen, hoogwaardige technische oplossingen te verkopen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan groei. Een zelfstandige baan voor een ondernemende accountmanager die kansen ziet én benut!

Maak het verschil als Accountmanager Bouw en Techniek in Nederland

Dankzij jouw commerciële daadkracht groeit IKO's positie in de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting. Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig nieuwe klantrelaties en brengt hoogwaardige oplossingen onder de aandacht bij onder andere aannemers, voorschrijvers, woningcorporaties en vastgoedbeheerders. Denk aan waterdichtingstoepassingen voor balkons, galerijen, parkeerdaken en -dekken, dakdetails en brugdekken. Je onderzoekt de markt, signaleert bouw- en renovatieprojecten en weet op het juiste moment de juiste gesprekspartners te bereiken. Daarbij verkoop je op technische meerwaarde en bouw je aan langdurige samenwerkingen. Je start met een kleine bestaande klantenportefeuille en richt je aanvankelijk op new business om jouw portefeuille verder uit te breiden. Je bent regelmatig onderweg naar klanten en projecten, werkt verder regelmatig vanuit huis en bent uiteraard welkom op het kantoor in Klundert. Je schakelt met jouw Nederlandse en Belgische salescollega's en technische specialisten.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • zelfstandig ontwikkelen van de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting;
  • actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten, waaronder aannemers, voorschrijvers en andere potentiële opdrachtgevers;
  • signaleren en opvolgen van commerciële kansen binnen bouw-, renovatie- en infrastructurele projecten;
  • adviseren over hoogwaardige technische oplossingen en opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;
  • ontwikkelen van een sterke salespipeline en zorgvuldig vastleggen van commerciële activiteiten in Salesforce (CRM).

Als gedreven Accountmanager Bouw en Techniek kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige commerciële functie bij een internationaal familiebedrijf waar ondernemerschap en eigen initiatief worden gewaardeerd. IKO biedt je de ruimte om jouw markt te ontwikkelen, ondersteund door ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Tijdens jouw inwerkperiode leer je bovendien van het Belgische salesteam.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een salaris tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring;
  • een bonusregeling tot 10% van jouw jaarsalaris;
  • 25 vakantiedagen + 12 ATV dagen
  • een auto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak;
  • een pensioenregeling volgens Hibin;
  • veel vrijheid om jouw eigen agenda en commerciële activiteiten te organiseren;
  • de mogelijkheid om regelmatig vanuit huis te werken;
  • toegang tot kennis en expertise binnen een internationale organisatie.

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het openen van deuren en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt gestructureerd en houdt koers tijdens langdurige verkooptrajecten. Met jouw nieuwsgierigheid en technische interesse achterhaal je de werkelijke klantbehoefte. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende gesprekspartners, van uitvoerende aannemers tot technisch adviseurs, en weet hen met inhoudelijke argumenten te overtuigen.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar commerciële buitendienstervaring, bij voorkeur als accountmanager of technisch-commercieel adviseur;
  • aantoonbare ervaring met directe verkoop aan aannemers en actieve acquisitie;
  • technische affiniteit, bij voorkeur met bouwproducten, waterdichting, coatings of infrastructurele toepassingen;
  • ervaring met CRM-systemen, bij voorkeur Salesforce, en goede kennis van Excel.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw werkgebied beslaat heel Nederland, met een focusgebied in de driehoek Rotterdam, Utrecht en Amsterdam. Je werkt veel vanuit huis en bezoekt zelfstandig klanten, prospects en projecten. Je deelt jouw agenda grotendeels zelf in en stemt afspraken af op de commerciële kansen in jouw regio. Regelmatig heb je contact met collega's op de Nederlandse vestiging in Klundert. Voor trainingen en salesmeetings bezoek je incidenteel het Europese hoofdkantoor in Antwerpen.

Werken bij IKO

IKO is een internationaal familiebedrijf en producent van hoogwaardige dakbedekkings-, isolatie- en waterdichtingsoplossingen. Ze zijn marktleider en staan voor kwaliteit. Met circa 4.000 medewerkers wereldwijd levert de organisatie technische producten voor uiteenlopende bouw- en infrastructuurprojecten.

Binnen de productgroep IKO flexia ligt de focus op vloeibare waterdichting voor specialistische toepassingen, binnen dit segment zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe collega.

De organisatie is actief in meer dan 40 landen en heeft haar Europese hoofdkantoor in Antwerpen. IKO werd in 1951 opgericht in Canada en is nog altijd een echt familiebedrijf. De cultuur is nuchter, lean en hands-on: een ‘doe’-mentaliteit met veel vrijheid, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en korte lijnen.

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Compliance at Mollie is a competitive advantage — and you'll be the one building it. As a Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do.

As a Talent Acquisition Business Partner, you'll play a key role in attracting and hiring the talent that drives Tellent's growth. You'll own end-to-end recruitment across different business functions, from Product & Engineering to Go-to-Market, partnering with hiring managers to develop effective hiring strategies and deliver a great candidate experience.

Talent Acquisition is a dedicated function within our wider People Team. You'll work closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners and other People colleagues to understand business priorities and translate them into recruitment strategies.

We're looking for an all-round recruiter who combines strong sourcing skills with a genuine business partnering mindset. Someone who isn't afraid to challenge hiring requirements, question assumptions and bring market insights to the table. As internal users of our own products, you'll also collaborate with our Product teams to share feedback and identify opportunities to improve our recruitment tools and experience.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: Get familiar with our business, teams and recruitment processes. Build relationships with key stakeholders and take ownership of active recruitment processes.

  • Within 6 months: Independently manage recruitment across multiple functions, develop sourcing strategies and build talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

  • After 1 year: Become a trusted business partner to hiring teams, contribute to talent acquisition strategy and drive continuous improvements across our recruitment processes and tools.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end recruitment: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across different functions, from intake meetings and sourcing to offer management.

  • Partner with the business: Work closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to understand business needs and develop effective hiring strategies.

  • Challenge and advise: Question hiring requirements, challenge assumptions and bring talent market insights to hiring decisions.

  • Drive proactive sourcing: Identify and engage active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals and other channels.

  • Build talent pipelines: Develop and maintain talent pools for current and future hiring needs.

  • Improve how we work: Monitor recruitment performance, identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with our Product teams to share feedback as an internal user of Tellent.

What You Bring

  • Several years of experience in Talent Acquisition or recruitment, ideally in an in-house environment.

  • Experience managing end-to-end recruitment across different functions, ideally covering both Product & Engineering and Go-to-Market roles.

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology or fast-growing scale-up environment is a strong plus.

  • Strong sourcing skills and experience building talent pipelines, including engaging passive candidates.

  • Confidence in partnering with and constructively challenging hiring managers and senior stakeholders.

  • A good understanding of talent markets and the ability to translate business needs into realistic hiring strategies.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working from our canal-side Amsterdam office

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget + 2 dedicated learning days

  • Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days in 2026

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • €200 home office budget + work-from-home allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works?   • ontwikkelen, implementeren en evalueren van HR-beleid en optimaliseren en borgen van HR-processen;
  • coördineren van de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris, inclusief recruitment, en het begeleiden en aansturen van collega's binnen het team;
  • goed gevoel voor relevante wet en regelgeving rond arbeidsrecht, verzuim en beloning, en het vermogen om tijdig juridische of fiscale aandachtspunten te signaleren.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je bent een stevige HR professional die zelfstandig werkt, overzicht houdt en gemakkelijk schakelt tussen verschillende gesprekspartners. Je voelt je prettig in een rol waarin je adviseert, zaken voor elkaar krijgt en collega's begeleidt. Daarbij combineer je een proactieve, praktische en resultaatgerichte instelling met een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • voldoende kennis van arbeidsrecht, de Wet verbetering poortwachter en fiscaliteit rond beloningssystematiek;
  • ervaring met verzuimtrajecten;
  • affiniteit met het ontwikkelen van beleid en het verbeteren van processen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, op tien minuten lopen van Leiden Centraal. Dankzij deze centrale ligging is het kantoor uitstekend bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer. Vanuit Leiden werk je nauw samen met leidinggevenden, management en jouw directe HR-collega’s. De functie biedt daarmee een centrale uitvalsbasis voor jouw werk binnen de organisatie.

Benefits

Als gedreven HR adviseur kun jij rekenen op:

Veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen bij een organisatie met korte lijnen, waar goede ideeën snel besproken én uitgevoerd kunnen worden. Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. data.description:
The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together.

Our current tech includes:

  • Data warehouse: BigQuery

  • Ingestion: Stitch

  • Transformation: dbt Cloud

  • Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight


What you’ll do

  • Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.

  • Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.

  • Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.

  • Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

  • AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer.

  • Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table.

Working with AI

AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. 

The Team

You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. 


Who you are

  • You have owned analytics engineering work end to end.

  • You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core).

  • You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec.

  • You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language.

  • You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce.

  • You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled.

  • You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering.

How we hire

There are four stages:

  • 30-minute call with our recruiter.

  • 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

  • 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task.

  • 30-minute conversation with a senior leader.

What we have for you

Competitive compensation  

  • 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth  

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.  

Time to recharge  

  • 25 vacation days   

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs   

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview)   

Work from anywhere  

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.  

A team you’ll actually want to be part of  

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday   

  • Regular team moments and outings   

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond   

Set up for success  

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work   

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance   

An environment to grow and make impact  

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.  
     

About Talk360  

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number.

 

Here’s what our users say:  

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★  

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★  

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

The Challenge 
Much of what Talk360 users see and touch is built with web technology - onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and calling in the browser - on top of a Ruby on Rails platform. Every change you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people in more than 190 countries, often on older devices, limited data plans and unreliable networks. For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. 

Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. 

What You'll Do 

Lead on frontend 

  • Build and improve our web experiences in React: onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and account features 

  • Help evolve our web dialer and the web side of our embedded calling product, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own platforms 

  • Shape frontend architecture and technical direction, working closely with the Tech Lead and the rest of the team 

  • Bring our design system to the web with consistent, accessible components across all our apps 

  • Own frontend quality: performance on low-end devices and slow networks, releases, monitoring and error tracking 

Work across the stack 

  • Take features end-to-end: build the Rails API and data model your frontend needs, instead of waiting for it 

  • Contribute to our Ruby on Rails platform, the backend behind our mobile apps, web apps and partner integrations 

  • Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD and tooling so we can ship often and with confidence 

  • Raise the level of the team through technical designs, code reviews and sharing what you know 

Learn from customers, build AI-first 

  • Ship features and experiments on the journeys that matter most to our users, from first open to buying credit 

  • Use data, error reports and user feedback to find and fix what hurts users most 

  • Work with Product and Design before implementation to shape solutions, not just execute them 

  • Use AI tooling throughout your workflow to raise quality and speed, and help shape how we work as an AI-first engineering team 

The Team 

You'll be working alongside Isah (Frontend), Oleg (Full Stack), Alex (Backend), Yahaya (VoIP and Data Platform), Igor (iOS and Mobile Lead), David (Android), and Tom (Tech Lead). The wider tech team you'll collaborate with includes Michal & Ali (QA). On the product side, you'll work closely with Quintin and Kseniia (Product) and Cameron (Design). 

Talk360 is a lean company, around 30 people globally, which means you'll interact regularly across functions: ops, support, data, and marketing. That cross-functional visibility is one of the things that makes the work here interesting and your impact visible.

Must have 

  • React and TypeScript in production 

  • Modern HTML and CSS, responsive and mobile-first 

  • Web performance: making apps fast on low-end devices and slow networks 

  • Solid backend experience with Ruby on Rails: API design and relational databases (we use MySQL) 

  • Experience owning production applications end-to-end, from technical design to operations 

  • Experience implementing automated tests (unit, component and end-to-end) and working with CI/CD 

  • Git 

  • Actively using AI throughout your development workflow 

Nice to have 

  • Building or maintaining a design system or component library 

  • WebRTC, VoIP or real-time communication 

  • Payment and checkout flows 

  • Infrastructure experience: AWS (ECS, RDS), Docker, infrastructure as code 

  • Observability and analytics tooling (Sentry, Graylog, Mixpanel or similar) 

Who You Are 

  • You're a generalist with a frontend heart: you care about what users see and touch, and you'd rather own a problem end-to-end than stay in one layer of the stack.

  • You enjoy solving hard technical problems while thinking about the bigger picture.

  • You can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices. 

  • You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback.

data.title: Senior Customer Service Leader

data.description:
Amsterdam- DPG Media Advertising is in transitie. We zijn een marktleider en challenger in één. Wij zijn volop in beweging en schuiven op van traditionele mediapartner naar volwaardig strategisch business partner. Voor de absolute top adverteerders van Nederland zoeken wij een Strategisch Account Director die hierin voorop loopt.

Wat ga je doen
Van mediabudget naar bedrijfsgroei… Als Strategisch Account Director acteer je op het allerhoogste niveau binnen onze Key Account organisatie. Je beheert een selecte groep van onze meest strategische, complexe klanten. Samenwerkingen gaan hier veel verder dan de inkoop van media; je praat op directieniveau over businessdoelen, strategische partnerschips, data-integraties en langetermijnvisies.

Jij bent het boegbeeld van onze nieuwe koers en neemt zowel je klanten als onze interne organisatie mee in deze transitie. Je schakelt continu op twee snelheden: het bouwen aan verankerde, strategische samenwerkingen voor de komende jaren én het binnentikken van de kortetermijndoelstellingen. Dagelijkse werkzaamheden zijn o.a.:

  • Besturen van complexiteit: Je overziet moeiteloos het krachtenveld van grote organisaties en fungeert als de spin in het web voor een complexe matrix aan in- en externe stakeholders (directies, mediabureaus, creatieve bureaus, en interne DPG-specialisten). 

  • De stip op de horizon zetten (Helicopterview): Je stijgt boven de (campagne)details uit, legt verbanden tussen ogenschijnlijk losstaande ontwikkelingen en vertaalt maatschappelijke, politieke of markttrends naar concrete acties voor adverteerders en DPG.

  • Challenger mindset: Je zet strategische inzichten en jouw diepgaande (digitale)media kennis in om klanten met feiten en context uit te dagen. Je schroomt niet de status quo in twijfel te trekken. Je weegt langetermijneffecten af en maakt keuzes die duurzame relaties versterken, ook als dat betekent dat je op korte termijn kritisch moet zijn.

  • Voorbeeldgedrag en coaching: Als de meest senior professional in het team ben je een inhoudelijke vraagbaak, coach en inspirator voor collega’s op alle niveaus. Je motiveert hen om te groeien in hun commerciële en strategische vaardigheden. 


Wat maakt jou een ideale kandidaat?
Wij zoeken een gedreven en strategische denker die naadloos aansluit bij ons DPG DNA: Gedreven, Optimistisch, Betrokken en Creatief. Daarnaast ben je:

  • Kritisch en nieuwsgierig: Je neemt geen genoegen met oppervlakkige input. Je wil de vraag achter de vraag kennen en doorgrondt de échte businessuitdaging van de klant.

  • Eigenaarschap: Je neemt de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor commerciële doelstellingen, klantrelaties en (interne) processen die bijdragen aan afdelingsoverschrijdende successen.

  • Leervermogen: Je bent continu op de hoogte van alle ontwikkelingen en het (door)ontwikkelen van eigen kennis, nieuwe technieken, methodes of oplossingen. 

  • Zelfreflectie: Je staat open voor feedback, kent je eigen blinde vlekken en blijft altijd leren, want de digitale markt staat geen seconde stil.

  • Ondernemend: Je wacht niet op een briefing, maar creëert zelf de vraag door redactie, tech, data en sales samen te brengen tot vernieuwende proposities en  grensverleggende partnerships


Verder breng je mee:

  • Hbo- of wo- werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 8 jaar commerciële werkervaring op strategisch klantniveau, opgedaan binnen de digitale media- of bureauwereld.

  • Bewezen track record in partnership denken met complexe accounts en stakeholdermanagement op directieniveau.

  • Zeer diepgaande en actuele kennis van het digitale (ad-tech) landschap, datastrategieën en de dynamiek met globale techspelers.

  • Creatieve denkkracht om adverteerders en collega's continu te blijven verrassen met originele invalshoeken en out-of-the-box (media)oplossingen 

  • Je anticipeert op ontwikkelingen, maakt het eigen én levert actief input aan het team of de afdeling. 


Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een uitstekend salaris passend bij deze senior positie, afhankelijk van ervaring.

  • Een 32- tot 36-urige werkweek met hybride werkmogelijkheden.

  • Volop ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en ruimte voor eigenaarschap in een cultuur waar ambitie, plezier en diversiteit hand in hand gaan.

  • Interessante bonusregeling.

  • Een keuzebudget van 12% (waarvan 8% vakantiegeld) en een jaarlijkse winstregeling (o.b.v. resultaat van de organisatie).

  • Leaseauto/mobiliteitsbudget.

  • De kans om de commerciële strategie van het grootste mediahuis van Nederland direct te beïnvloeden.


Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Solliciteer dan direct!
Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct en uiterlijk 4 december 2026. Je krijgt binnen 10 werkdagen een reactie op je sollicitatie en te horen of je bij de eerste selectie zit. Zit je bij de eerste selectie, dan zullen we telefonisch contact met je opnemen om een afspraak in te plannen op ons kantoor in Amsterdam. Meer weten, neem dan contact op met Robin (Recruiter) via .

Als hét grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland staan we open voor al het talent in de maatschappij. Wij roepen kandidaten met een diverse achtergrond in de breedste zin van het woord dan ook op om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom.

Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken
Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma's, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen. We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega's te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquizteam of een sportteam is. Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben. En, als je toch bezig bent, vind je ons ook op Instagram, LinkedIn en X. voor commerciële doelstellingen, klantrelaties en (interne) processen die bijdragen aan afdelingsoverschrijdende successen.

data.description:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Ketenregisseur voor het Ministerie van Financiën, binnen het directoraat-generaal Herstel Toeslagen (DGH). DGH coördineert het traject van en voor gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire en voert regie op zowel het herstelbeleid als de uitvoeringsketen en gemeenten.

Binnen DGH richt de Taskforce Versnelling Bezwaren zich op het versnellen van de bezwaarafhandeling. Om deze versnelling effectief uit te voeren, is het belangrijk dat UHT samen met haar ketenpartners dossiers en deelproducten tijdig en in het benodigde volume oplevert. Hiervoor moet de gehele keten optimaal functioneren.

Als ketenregisseur bewaak je directieoverstijgend en doorlopend deze keten. Je ziet toe op goed vraag- en aanbodmanagement, werkt samen met professionals aan procesoptimalisatie en adviseert verschillende directies over de aansturing vanuit ketenperspectief. Je legt verantwoording af aan de directeur BBI.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je voert regie op de keten van het opvragen van dossiers tot het doorzetten naar de Bezwaar Advies Commissie (BAC).

  • Je haalt prioriteiten op en stemt deze af met de betrokken partijen.

  • Je bewaakt doorlooptijden en voorraden binnen de keten.

  • Je initieert en leidt het wekelijkse ketenoverleg en zorgt voor een heldere actie- en besluitenlijst.

  • Je signaleert en escaleert knelpunten en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen worden geborgd.

  • Je zorgt voor een actueel ketenoverzicht met afspraken en aanspreekpunten, een wekelijkse monitor en een duidelijke escalatieroute.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede overdracht aan de lijn.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je beschikt over minimaal WO werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door een afgeronde WO-opleiding en/of minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring op WO-niveau.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met functionele aansturing van medewerkers.

  • Je hebt minimaal 8 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring in een schakelfunctie tussen beleid en uitvoering.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt kennis van beleidsvorming, governance en bestuurlijke samenwerking met inhoudelijke technische kwalificatie van schaderoutes.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van meerdere processen en/of projecten en samenwerking met diverse stakeholders.

  • Je hebt ervaring en/of affiniteit met de organisatie.

Competenties

Resultaatgericht; Oplossingsgericht; Analytisch sterk; Communicatief sterk; Samenwerken; Besluitvaardig; Organisatiesensitiviteit; Omgevingsbewustzijn.

Informatie 

Start: Zo spoedig mogelijk

Aantal uur: 32 tot 36 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging

Locatie: Den Haag

Vorm: Detachering (niet geschikt voor zzp)

Geïnteresseerd?

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 30 november 9:00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Leonie van Hove, Managing Consultant Interim Management, 06 45 39 02 31,

data.description:
Wie ben jij

Jij bent een pragmatische IT‑specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je houdt van techniek, maar krijgt vooral energie van het stabiel en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van platformen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, regie en samenwerking. Je behoudt overzicht in complexe ketens en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • HBO werk‑ en denkniveau richting IT; 

  • ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer of Platform Engineer;

  • ervaring met services en (SaaS) oplossingen op Microsoft Azure;

  • praktische kennis van Kubernetes / containers / application gateways (bij voorkeur AKS);

  • ervaring met informatie analyse, operations, beheerprocessen en incidentafhandeling; 

  • kennis van monitoring tooling (pré: Dynatrace);

  • ervaring met CI/CD en OTAP‑omgevingen;

  • kennis van networking, routing, firewalls en DNS, App en Lowcode oplossingen;

  • affiniteit met security, identity en toegangsbeheer (AD / Entra ID);

  • ervaring met samenwerken en regie op leveranciers of MSP‑partijen;

  • je communiceert helder, werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen

Bij Univé werken we iedere dag aan zekerheid voor onze leden. Dat doen we niet alleen met verzekeringen, maar ook met betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening. Binnen IT Kern bouwen en beheren we het fundament waarop onze dienstverlening draait. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, continuïteit en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Het team Frontend Platform speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Wij zorgen ervoor dat onze websites, klantomgevingen en digitale contactkanalen stabiel, veilig en  toekomstbestendig functioneren. Denk hierbij aan frontendplatformen, CRM‑omgevingen, monitoring, identity & access management, cloudplatformen en integraties met andere ketens. Vanwege verdere professionalisering van ons platform zoeken wij een IT Specialist Frontend Platform. Een pragmatische IT‑specialist die techniek begrijpt én overzicht houdt in de keten. De komende jaren staan onder andere een managed service partner transitie, implementatie van ons ledencontact platform, verdere standaardisatie, lifecyclemanagement, security‑verbeteringen en professionalisering van beheerprocessen centraal. Deze thema’s sluiten aan op de bredere IT Kern doelstellingen rondom stabiliteit, schaalbaarheid, monitoring, governance en professionalisering van IT‑processen.

Als IT Specialist Frontend Platform zorg jij ervoor dat onze platformen stabiel, voorspelbaar en veilig functioneren. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen techniek, operations, leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook hoe processen, beheer, changes en samenwerking in de praktijk werken. Je overziet de gehele keten en weet verstoringen structureel op te lossen. In deze rol ligt de nadruk nadrukkelijk op continuïteit, regie, beheer en samenwerking binnen de keten. Daarbij werk je zowel hands‑on als coördinerend.

Wat bieden wij

Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal platform voor Univé. veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen Frontend Platform. Een afwisselende rol waarin techniek, beheer en samenwerking samenkomen. De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern.

Hybride werken vanuit Zwolle en thuis.

 

Overige Arbeidsvoorwaarden  

  • jaarsalaris is minimaal € 57.487 en maximaal € 81.163 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning);

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 

 

Drie focusgebieden

De IT-organisatie is vanaf 1 januari 2025 ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders.

Het team Frontend Platform
Binnen Frontend Platform werken we aan het beheer en de continuïteit van platformen die direct bijdragen aan de digitale dienstverlening van Univé. Daarbij werken we nauw samen met DevOps‑teams, architectuur, security, leveranciers en andere platformteams. Het team richt zich onder andere op:

Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar het MKB en wil je ontdekken hoe zakelijke verzekeringen in de praktijk werken? Vanaf februari 2027 kun je stage lopen bij het MKB team van Univé Zuid-Nederland. Je kijkt mee met onze zakelijke adviseurs, leert hoe we ondernemers helpen bij hun verzekeringsvragen en steekt zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Een mooie kans om werkervaring op te doen, nieuwe mensen te leren kennen en te ontdekken waar jouw talent ligt!

Wie ben jij

Je bent een enthousiaste student die graag leert door te doen. Je vindt het interessant om te ontdekken wat ondernemers bezighoudt en hoe je hen verder kunt helpen. Je stelt vragen, luistert goed en durft initiatief te nemen. Ervaring met verzekeringen is niet nodig: nieuwsgierigheid en de wil om te leren vinden we belangrijker. Of je nu vooral wilt meelopen of juist actief wilt meewerken, je denkt graag mee en werkt zorgvuldig samen met anderen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Je volgt een Mbo 4 of Hbo opleiding waarbij een meewerk- of afstudeerstage past.

  • Je kunt vanaf februari 2027 met je stage beginnen.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar het MKB en verzekeringen.

  • Je vindt het leuk om met mensen in contact te zijn.

  • Je communiceert helder en gaat zorgvuldig met informatie om.

  • Je neemt initiatief, stelt vragen en staat open voor feedback.

Wat ga je doen

Tijdens jouw stage maak je kennis met onze zakelijke afdeling MKB. Je ontdekt hoe we ondernemers adviseren over bedrijfsrisico's en passende verzekeringen. Je kijkt mee bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze zakelijke adviseurs en leert hoe een klantvraag van eerste contact tot opvolging wordt opgepakt. Wat je zelf gaat doen, hangt af van jouw leerdoelen, opleiding en de mogelijkheden binnen het team.

Je staat er niet alleen voor: collega's nemen je mee in hun werk en helpen je de zakelijke verzekeringswereld te leren kennen. Je krijgt ruimte om vragen te stellen en mee te denken over hoe we onze leden nog beter kunnen ondersteunen. Zoek je vooral een oriënterende meeloopstage of wil je tijdens een meewerkstage zelfstandig taken oppakken? We bespreken samen welke invulling het beste aansluit bij jouw opleiding.

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je kijkt mee met zakelijke adviseurs en leert hoe klantgesprekken worden voorbereid en opgevolgd.

  • Je ondersteunt, onder begeleiding, bij het verzamelen en verwerken van klantinformatie.

  • Je helpt waar passend bij offertes, klantdossiers en andere werkzaamheden binnen het MKB-team.

  • Je denkt mee over verbeteringen in de dienstverlening aan ondernemers en werkt aan je leerdoelen.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Univé Zuid-Nederland krijg je de kans om ervaring op te doen in een betrokken team en te ontdekken hoe de zakelijke verzekeringsmarkt werkt. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op:

  • Een meeloop- of meewerkstage met start in februari 2027.

  • Een stagevergoeding voor €500,- per maand.

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen bij ons MKB-team en onze zakelijke dienstverlening.

  • De kans om mee te kijken met adviseurs en, waar passend, zelf taken op te pakken.

  • Praktijkervaring met klantcontact, samenwerking en het ondersteunen van ondernemers.

  • Ruimte om vragen te stellen, mee te denken en jouw talenten te ontdekken.
